business_summary: DTC women's apparel brand offering inclusive sizing from 00-40, focusing on high quality for women who struggle to find extended sizes. Features an average order value of $140 and a generous one-year free exchange policy.
stated_claims: Stylish clothing for women in sizes 00-40

relevant_tags.why: Offers extended sizes up to size 40, catering to women seeking quality in plus sizes.
Operates as a direct-to-consumer digital brand.
Likely includes everyday casual apparel options.
Likely adjacent interest for women shopping for quality structured clothing.

persona_conflicts.evidence: Though exchanges are free for a year, clothing purchases often require high touch-and-feel cycle and exchanges, which may conflict with convenience-first speed preferences.

note_signals.why: Swiftcart deals in high-frequency, late-night impulse grocery/convenience purchases, which doesn't align well with a high-AOV apparel brand requiring fit considerations.
Marlowe & Co. attracts older affluent women who respond to quality messaging and high AOV, aligning well with the quality focus and $140 AOV.
Linden Park features high-AOV apparel shoppers, making them highly qualified buyers for a premium $140 AOV clothing brand.
Everbody has an audience that highly values fit-focused messaging and inclusive sizing, presenting a perfect demographic match.
Stride & Stem attracts professional women who appreciate quality and durability, which aligns with women looking for premium apparel.
